**Describe the bug**  
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Bug reports that were primarily generated by an LLM will not be accepted.**  
LLMs tend to create overly verbose prose, often go off on irrelevant tangents and mix high-level descriptions with
details that would take significant time to verify.
It is the duty of the person reporting a bug to provide a description that can be parsed in reasonable amount of time.
If maintainers suspect a report is created by an LLM without human verification and refinement they are free to close it
without further reason.
This does not mean maintainers do not care about bugs. Rather the contrary - the higher the quality of the report,
the more confident contributors can be that the fix they'll provide is a robust solution and the time they'll invest
into fixing it is time well spent.
